snippet.title: The Strange Box - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
The Strange Box
A 2D puzzle-solving adventure game that uses a unique art design to tell a dark fairy tale where fear, suspense, and fantasy intertwine.
A dark secret hides in the walls of an apartment complex, a child gnawed by a tormenting nightmare.

👁️_👁️
